mapper.insert: insert into academic_project ( project_id, user_id, title, research_question, target_venue, writing_status, progress_note, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{projectId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{researchQuestion}, #{targetVenue}, #{writingStatus}, #{progressNote}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) on duplicate key update title = values(title), research_question = values(research_question), target_venue = values(target_venue), writing_status = values(writing_status), progress_note = values(progress_note), update_time = values(update_time)

insert into academic_project_file ( project_id, user_id, file_id, file_name, file_type, folder_type, summary, content_preview, create_time ) values ( #{projectId}, #{userId}, #{fileId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{folderType}, #{summary}, #{contentPreview}, #{createTime} ) on duplicate key update file_name = values(file_name), file_type = values(file_type), folder_type = values(folder_type), summary = values(summary), content_preview = values(content_preview)
